ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white/light pixels (estimated 15-20%) relative to the dominant low-intensity black ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white ring-shaped blobs across both lobes; concentration of high-intensity clusters at the distal tips; central lower region adjacent to the peduncle is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees between the lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; notable high-amplitude peaks and valleys localized on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes extending from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular and annular white pixel clusters (5-40 pixel diameter) distributed across the black background of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint horizontal and diagonal linear pixel disruptions breaking the black pigmentation, primarily visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Encrusting barnacle colonies visible as high-contrast, irregular tan and white masses on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'donut' scarring pattern characterized by low-intensity centers surrounded by high-intensity white circular perimeters.
